title: Is This Collection Worth My LLM’s Time? Automatically Measuring Information Potential in Text Corpora

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of the correct answer position (A, B, C, or D) generated by the model in multiple-choice questions, and measuring the model's tendency to favor specific options (e.g., B and C) over others. The bias is mitigated and evaluated by rotating the correct answer through all four positions and evaluating the questions independently.
